title: FMMS Alert
description: Canonical wire format for alerts produced by the rule engine and consumed by the alert service. Three Kafka topics share this schema differentiated by the 'kind' field: alerts.threshold, alerts.malfunction, alerts.priority.

alert_id.description: Globally unique. Used by the alert service for deduplication.

kind.description: threshold = parameter exceeded a configured limit (FR-06); malfunction = sensor down or status=0 (FR-07); priority = imminent danger / escalation (FR-09 / FR-08).

severity.description: Drives UI styling and routing. 'high' bypasses standard processing (architecture.md §8 Performance/prioritize-events tactic).

sensor_id.description: Originating sensor, when applicable. Null for area-level alerts (e.g. a redundancy escalation that aggregates multiple sensors).

parameter.description: Parameter that triggered the alert. Null for malfunction or area-level alerts.

value.description: Measured value at the moment of the alert. Null for malfunction.

threshold.description: Configured threshold the value crossed. Null for malfunction.

ts_event.description: Time of the originating sensor event.

ts_emitted.description: Time the rule engine produced this alert.

redundancy_remaining.description: For malfunction alerts: count of still-operational sensors covering this parameter in the area. Drives FR-08 escalation.

trend.description: For threshold alerts: short-window trend at the moment of breach.

originating_alert_id.description: For priority alerts that escalate from a threshold or malfunction alert.
